title: 通过LLM提示实现古典拉丁语命名实体识别的迁移学习
summary: 本文描述了uOttawa团队在EvaLatin 2026共享任务中的系统，利用商业LLM（gemini-2.5-pro和claude-sonnet-4-5）的提示工程，对古典拉丁语进行粗粒度和细粒度命名实体识别。通过跨语言迁移学习，在严格和模糊评估下均取得第一名，展示了LLM对低资源古代语言研究的价值。
summary_en: This paper describes Team uOttawa's system for the EvaLatin 2026 NER shared task, using prompt engineering of commercial LLMs (gemini-2.5-pro and claude-sonnet-4-5) for coarse- and fine-grained named entity recognition in Classical Latin. Achieving first place in both subtasks under strict and fuzzy regimes, it demonstrates the value of cross-lingual transfer learning for low-resource ancient languages.
